core_nearly_full: The threads around your soul pull taut, Cantor. Listen for where they lead.

core_nearly_full.text: Light the candle soon. The name the Spell will give you is already on its tongue.

core_full: Your soul hums at the edge of its rank. The Spell hears it.

core_full.text: Seek the {next_category} Category. The Spell will not say it louder than this.

seed_next_category: Follow the thread that sounds lowest. The Seed lies under it.
Its Guardian has a name too. Learn it before you enter.
new_region: Every creature here has a name. Learn them, and they will answer.
The stars over {region} are older than its walls.
unclaimed_citadel: Its Gateway still remembers the last voice that held it.
A clan that claims it will be heard across the Dream Realm.
idle: Even a Cantor must sing to be heard.
The Spell keeps your name close. It would like to say it again.
